description: session-hub-scope-guard: in a child session, blocks file writes outside the scope root

hooks.command: MSYS2_ENV_CONV_EXCL="SESSION_HUB_${MSYS2_ENV_CONV_EXCL:+;$MSYS2_ENV_CONV_EXCL}" node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scope-guard.mjs" || { rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 2 ] && exit 2; r=$(printf %s "${SESSION_HUB_ROLE:-}" | tr -d '[:space:]' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); g=$(printf %s "${SESSION_HUB_GUARDS:-}" | tr -d '[:space:]' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); case "$r" in ''|none|master) exit 0;; esac; [ "$g" = off ] && exit 0; echo "[session-hub] Write blocked: the scope guard could not run (exit $rc)." >&2; exit 2; }
